QuestInfo.name: [Chocky Day] Episode 3 (Part II)
QuestInfo.0:
All was quiet the eve of Chocky Day, until Peplock Holmes discovered his extensive Chocky collection had mysteriously vanished! His feathers ruffled, the good detective requests the help of a warrior to aid his investigation, and you are happy to oblige. Thus began the curious case of the missing Chocky.
